title: Robust Zero-Shot NER for Crises via Iterative Knowledge Distillation and Confidence-Gated Induction

contributions.purpose: 在无标注的危机冷启动场景做零样本NER
contributions.mechanism: 置信门控迭代归纳框架:RoBERTa高召回候选→阈值0.6选高置信种子→HDBSCAN聚类构microgazetteer+PMI句法规则→自纠正循环三轮精炼
contributions.evaluation: 零样本F1恒定约0.295(<0.33),迭代未超过naive基线
contributions.domain: 危机响应零样本命名实体识别(NER)
contributions.source_quote: A confidence-gated iterative induction framework is introduced... iteratively distills domain knowledge through a self-correcting loop that uses high-confidence seeds to induce micro-gazetteers and syntactic rules.

contributions.mechanism: leave-one-event-out协议下与静态(无迭代)基线对比多次迭代
contributions.evaluation: 迭代机制在当前配置下无任何可测量提升,F1稳定在约0.295
contributions.source_quote: the framework maintains a constant zero-shot F1-score of roughly 0.295 with current hyperparameter settings, indicating that the iterative mechanism provides no measurable improvement in its current form.

contributions.purpose: 剖析失败根因供后续研究
contributions.mechanism: 错误分析+案例研究(阈值校准、聚类粒度、误差传播)
contributions.evaluation: 0.6阈值滤掉中置信但正确的实体;HDBSCAN聚类过粗;早期错误传播,系统强化初始偏差而非修正
contributions.source_quote: the system often reinforces initial biases. These difficulties highlight the challenges of robust, adaptive NER in real-world crises

self_declared_provenance.quote: This design builds on a variety of self-training paradigms (Rajeev et al., 2025; Wang et al., 2021) but specifically targets crisis NER to highlight emergent lexicons and structured domain knowledge.

notes: AI披露checklist全部[D]。这是一篇诚实的负结果论文:作者反复自认'no measurable improvement'/'negative finding',F1恒定~0.295=naive基线。数字披露透明、无雷同或虚构迹象。数据为合成crisis语料。协议适配良好。desk-reject(负结果但方法平淡)。
